breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains Bi = 5 and proceeds with the lumped-capacitance method without any correction or warning. The ground truth requires either reducing Bi to 0.05 (< 0.1) for the lumped-capacitance method to be valid, or switching to a spatially resolved transient conduction model for Bi ≈ 5. The agent did neither — it repeated the original error by applying the lumped-capacitance method with Bi = 5.
